name: Put it on the back burner

meaning.zh:
“将它放在次要位置” 或 “暂时搁置”。

这个短语起源于厨房，指将一个锅放在炉子的后灶上，因为它不是当前最重要的，所以要暂时放在一边。这个短语现在广泛用于形容在工作或生活中暂时放弃处理某件事情的优先级，将注意力集中在更紧迫或重要的任务上。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from the kitchen, where placing a pot on the back burner implies it is not the most important item at the moment and can be set aside temporarily. Today, it is commonly used to describe postponing or deprioritizing a task so that more urgent or important matters can be addressed first.

lines.en: We need to *put the marketing project on the back burner* until we finish the product launch.
lines.zh: 我们需要暂时搁置市场推广项目，直到产品发布完成。

lines.en: She decided to *put her studies on the back burner* while she dealt with some family issues.
lines.zh: 她决定暂时搁置学业，处理一些家庭问题。

lines.en: With all the urgent deadlines, we'll have to *put this plan on the back burner* for now.
lines.zh: 由于所有紧急的截止日期，我们现在得暂时搁置这个计划。
